desk.headline: Half-year profit up 7.5% to ¥1.0tn; full-year profit forecast raised to ¥1.9tn, buyback expanded; past figures corrected

other.label: Profit attributable to owners of parent

results: Profit attributable to shareholders rose 7.5% to ¥1.0tn in the six months to September, from ¥933.5bn.
Gross profit grew 19% to ¥2.74tn and net business profit 22% to ¥1.40tn; diluted EPS was ¥131.98 versus ¥120.99 (split-adjusted).
Interim dividend of ¥100 per share; a two-for-one share split took effect on 1 October 2026.
SMFG corrected last year's accounts after an error in valuing monetary claims bought: 31 March 2026 net assets fall by ¥68.2bn, with no change to reported profit.
The correction trims the 31 March CET1 ratio to 12.32% from 12.41%; the June 2026 ratios are unchanged.

guidance.summary: SMFG raised its full-year profit forecast to ¥1.9tn (forecast EPS ¥250.84) and expanded its share buyback; press reports put the earlier forecast at ¥1.7tn and the extra buyback at ¥220bn.

items.metric: Profit attributable to owners of parent

items.new: ¥200 on a pre-split basis (year-end ¥50 per post-split share)

points: CEO Toru Nakashima warned a slowdown in data centre investment could affect results over the next six months.
He said SMFG has tightened data centre lending standards, limiting it to highly rated hyperscalers.
The buyback was expanded by a reported ¥220bn, bringing the year's total to about ¥400bn.

watch: Exposure to data centre lending as investment in the sector slows.
Any further corrections or controls findings after the restatement of last year's accounts.
CET1 ratio trend, down to 11.99% from 12.32% in six months, alongside the larger buyback.
